synthesis.body: A transform that strips or reads "the page title H1" must match at the start of the body (re.match on the lstripped text), not re.search anywhere in it. Markdown files contain `# ` lines that are not headings at all: shell comments inside fenced code blocks. In this repo that is 42 lines across 14 guides. A free search treats the first of them as the page title — promoting a bash comment when deriving a title, and silently DELETING it from the code sample when stripping. Silent content loss across a whole generated site is the failure mode, and it shows up in no build or lint output. Anchoring to the leading block is the fix; a fence-aware scan is needed only if you must find non-leading headings too.

title: Anchor markdown H1 transforms to the start of the body, never a free search
